judgement_by: Hon.Dr. D. F. H. Gunawardhana, J.
keywords: The Petitioner is a company which publishes daily and weekly newspapers, and the 4th Respondent, who is a freelance contributor, claimed that he is a permanent employee of the Petitioner and made an application to the 1st Respondent to decide upon his gratuity and the contribution by the Petitioner. Without giving any opportunity to present its defense, the 1st to 3rd Respondents had taken a decision that there exists an employer-employee relationship and therefore, the Petitioner is liable to contribute to gratuity; the Petitioner challenges the same. Held – since there is no proof of employer- employee relationship, writ issued.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
